reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds case-insensitive provider, model name, and model ID search to the model selector without changing routing or credentials.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器提供按提供商名称、模型名称或模型 ID 搜索和筛选的客户端界面增强。
summaries.en: Adds client-side search and filtering by provider name, model name, or model ID to the DeepSeek Harness model selector.

capabilities: Adds search and filtering to the DeepSeek Harness model selector
